traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria marked as implemented in docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md are satisfied by the current code, tests, and documentation. The ESLint plugin provides auto-fix behavior for missing @story annotations on functions and methods (require-story-annotation) and for simple, safe story path suffix normalization (valid-annotation-format). Fixes are conservative, only adjust comments, and preserve formatting/structure. These behaviors are thoroughly tested in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts using RuleTester with explicit before/after code outputs. User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md clearly documents what --fix does for both rules and their safety constraints. Requirements explicitly identified as “not yet implemented” in the story (configurable templates and selective toggles) are intentionally out of scope for this iteration and do not conflict with the current acceptance criteria. Therefore, Story 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX is fully implemented as specified.
